\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyfoot{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

\addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{-0.375in}
\addtolength{\evensidemargin}{-0.375in}
\addtolength{\textwidth}{1.1in}
\addtolength{\topmargin}{-0.8in}
\addtolength{\textheight}{1.5in}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedbottom
\raggedright
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0in}

\titleformat{\section}{
  \vspace{-9pt}\scshape\raggedright\large
}{}{0em}{}[\color{black}\titlerule \vspace{-7pt}]

{% raw %}
\newcommand{\resumeItem}[2]{
  \item\small{
    \textbf{#1}{: #2 \vspace{-2pt}}
  }
}

\newcommand{\resumeSubheading}[4]{
  \vspace{-1pt}\item
    \begin{tabular*}{0.97\textwidth}{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
      \textbf{#1} & #2 \\
      \textit{\small#3} & \textit{\small #4} \\
    \end{tabular*}\vspace{-10pt}
}
{% endraw %}

\renewcommand{\labelitemii}{$\circ$}

\newcommand{\resumeSubHeadingListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]}
\newcommand{\resumeSubHeadingListEnd}{\end{itemize}}
\newcommand{\resumeItemListStart}{\begin{itemize}}
\newcommand{\resumeItemListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-5pt}}

\hypersetup{
    colorlinks=false,
    pdfborder={0 0 0},
}

\begin{document}

\begin{tabular*}{\textwidth}{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
  \textbf{\Large {{ fullName | latex }}}\\
   {Linkedin: \href{ {{ linkedin }} }{ {{ linkedin | latex }} }} &  {Email: \href{mailto:{{ email }}}{ {{ email | latex }} }}\\
  \href{ {{ github }} }{GitHub: {{ github | latex }}} & {Mobile: {{ phone | latex }}}\\
{% if targetRole %}
  \multicolumn{2}{l}{\textit{Location: {{ location | latex }} | Target: {{ targetRole | latex }}}} \\
{% else %}
  \multicolumn{2}{l}{\textit{Location: {{ location | latex }}}} \\
{% endif %}
\end{tabular*}

{% if summary %}
\vspace{4pt}
\small{ {{ summary | latex }} }
{% endif %}

\section{Education}
  \resumeSubHeadingListStart
{% for edu in education %}
    \resumeSubheading
      { {{ edu.school | latex }} }{ {{ edu.location | latex }} }
      { {{ edu.degree | latex }} }{ {{ edu.period | latex }} }
{% endfor %}
  \resumeSubHeadingListEnd

\section{Experience}
  \resumeSubHeadingListStart
{% for exp in experience %}
    \resumeSubheading
      { {{ exp.company | latex }} }{ {{ exp.period | latex }} }
      { {{ exp.role | latex }} }{\textbf{\textit{Tech Stack: }} {{ exp.techStack | latex }} }
      \resumeItemListStart
{% for bullet in exp.bullets %}
        \resumeItem{ {{ bullet.title | latex }} }
          { {{ bullet.body | latex }} }
{% endfor %}
      \resumeItemListEnd
{% endfor %}
  \resumeSubHeadingListEnd

\section{Other Work}
  \resumeSubHeadingListStart
{% for project in projects %}
    \resumeSubheading
      { {{ project.title | latex }} }{ }
      { {{ project.subtitle | latex }} }{\textbf{\textit{Utilized: }} {{ project.techStack | latex }} }
      \resumeItemListStart
{% for bullet in project.bullets %}
        \resumeItem{ {{ bullet.title | latex }} }
          { {{ bullet.body | latex }} }
{% endfor %}
      \resumeItemListEnd
{% endfor %}
  \resumeSubHeadingListEnd

\section{Skills}
\small{
{% for group in skillGroups %}
\textbf{ {{ group.label | latex }} :} {{ group['items'] | join(', ') | latex }} \\
{% endfor %}
}
